theme: Personal finance basics: emergency fund, 50/30/20 budgeting, good vs bad debt
headline: Build Your Financial Safety Net Today
body: An emergency fund covers 3-6 months expenses, protecting you from unexpected costs without derailing goals.
caption: Financial stability starts with preparation. Keep essentials covered, budget wisely, and understand which debts work for you. #EmergencyFund #SmartBudgeting #DebtManagement #FinancialWellness #MoneyMatters
